sutta: 1.11.1 the buddha said now what is not dharma should be pointed out now it's not dhamma if somebody teaches something which is not according to the dhamma and he claims that it is according to the dhamma and we know that it is not according to the dhamma then we should point it out now that it is not according to the dhamma otherwise it will harm many people if they learn the wrong dharma if we point out what is right dharma and what is wrong dharma then it will benefit many people a little later we will see another suta  nikaya
